notes: RBox expansion paired with biology-replace-0018 (in_genus loses functionality): gives a made-up relation (has_brask_partner, functional) the property the revision changes, applied to real instances in the prompt. Instances are real species, with the distinctness of the two candidates given in the prompt where the question needs it. The direct question and the first instance ('could also be') are no, the second ('does it follow that they are the same fish') is yes. The coined terms stay untranslated in the Chinese and Spanish prompts. hops counts the prompt facts as one bridge. Unrelated near and far ask other properties of real relations that the edit must not change. Locality references are the logical answers; scoring uses each model's own pre-edit answer. The second instance names two tagged individuals of one species rather than two well-known distinct species, so the premises are not obviously inconsistent and 'yes, they are the same fish' is the one fair answer.
